author: Inside Edition
description: Scientists are building a library of sorts on Antarctica, but you won't find books on shelves, or even a librarian on premises. That's because the contents will be stored in an ice cave deep underground, at a temperature of minus 61 degrees to preserve these archives of glacier ice. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Glacier Ice From Around The World Being Stored In Ice Cave In Antarctica

author: Inside Edition
description: People living in a Connecticut town say they are living in a real-life episode for Stranger Things. A constant 24/7 hum has been hovering over West Haven like a cloud of sound. Kimberly Nunes started a petition demanding that town leaders address the issue. West Haven's commissioner of human services used a sound level meter to measure the decibel levels. Residents believe the sound is coming from an industrial factory.
title: Where Is The Constant Hum In This Connecticut Town Coming From?

author: Inside Edition
description: An SUV ended up in the water off a boat ramp in Virginia beach, trapping a woman inside. A hero passerby leaped into action. One of the rescuers happened to be a Navy rescue swimmer. One rescuer smashed the rear window while another worked the windshield. The car was sinking fast. The SUV disappeared underwater but then the rescuers brought the driver to the surface. Everyone was hauled to safety by rope. Navy rescue swimmer 35-year-old Jeremy Way injured his hand.
title: Former Navy Rescue Swimmer Rescues Woman In Sinking SUV

author: Inside Edition
description: Actress Melissa Gilbert is one of 75 people who have submitted letters of support to the judge in Timothy Busfield's sex abuse case. Busfield denies the charges. Inside Edition spoke to attorney Jim Wicka, who represented a teen who worked as an extra on the 1994 film, "Little Big League," co-starring Busfield. In a civil lawsuit, the teenager claimed Busfield invited the extra into his trailer. Busfield was never criminally charged and denied the allegations. Wicka says the lawsuit was settled.
title: 75 Letters Of Support Sent To Judge In Timothy Busfield Case

author: Inside Edition
description: A Nebraska family encountered a real life Grinch days before Christmas when their beloved Hamburglar statue was stolen right from their lawn. Maggie Woodcock tells Inside Edition Digital that the statue was given to her home for the year from the local fire department her husband is a part of and was angry the ostentatious lawn ornament was gone. After some careful sleuthing she says she found out who did and got it back just in time for the holidays.
title: Nebraska Family Has Hamburglar Statue Stolen From Yard

author: Inside Edition
description: Students at the University of Texas at Arlington are being praised for their help in connection with a 34-year-old cold case murder.
title: College Class May Have Solved 30-Year-Old Cold Case #shorts

description: A Maryland family's driveway was filled to the max with packages.
title: Family Stunned By How Many Packages They Received #shorts
